systems.name: 2.1 Player Characters & Classes
systems.notes: Define 4+ character classes with unique abilities, stats, and inventory. Each class offers different survival and detection tools.
tasks: Design class system: Knight (tank), Rogue (stealth/detection), Cleric (heal/cleanse), Wizard (utility/AoE)
Stat system: health, speed, detection radius, spirit affinity

systems.name: 2.2 Inventory & Gear System
systems.notes: Players collect gear during runs. Gear persists across chapters. The lone survivor of a chapter receives a permanent enchanted item.
tasks: Gear stat modifiers (weapon damage, armour, detection boost)
Lone survivor reward: random enchanted item with unique modifier

systems.name: 2.3 Spirit Check Mechanic
systems.notes: Players can perform a Spirit Check to force a suspected Mimic to reveal their true form. Requires resources, has a cooldown, and can be used strategically.
tasks: Implement Spirit Check action (vote-based or individual)
On successful check: Mimic forced out of Infiltration mode
Resource cost: Spirit Check consumes a shared 'Faith' meter
False check penalty: lose Faith, brief stun on initiator

systems.name: 2.4 Revival & Graveyard System
systems.notes: Dead heroes revive at the graveyard near the entrance of the next dungeon. They retain gear but may have a temporary debuff.
tasks: Graveyard spawn point at chapter start
Revived players return with full health, slight stat debuff (1 chapter)
Ghosts spectate until next chapter begins
Visual: spectral form rising from graveyard
